messages:
Elena Ruiz: Quick UX callout for trace list in Error Analytics: when users copy a stack frame we currently copy raw text. Should we provide a markdown-friendly paste option (e.g., ```function at file:line```), plus raw text for tooling? Mocked two menu items in Figma: Copy (Plain), Copy (Markdown). Tom Walters: Love the markdown option for engineers dropping into GH issues. Keep Plain for automated ingestion. Maybe label as "Copy (raw)" and "Copy (markdown)" to be explicit. Priya Menon: Accessibility + clarity: menu labels should be short. Also ensure screen readers get the difference: aria-label could be "Copy frame as Markdown". Gabe Liu: Implementation note: markdown format should escape backticks and sanitize long file paths with ellipses. Also include function name and line number. Example: ```handleAuth() — src/auth/index.ts:128``` a11y-checker: Contrast & target size: copy menu needs min 44px touch target on mobile and 3:1 contrast for interactive items in the menu list. Elena Ruiz: Good. Another related point: when users export traces we auto-generate filenames. Current pattern is: trace--2026-03-23.json. Want to add context token like app or environment? e.g., trace---2026-03-23.json ? Thoughts? Tom Walters: Adding app is helpful but could leak internal names for shared links. Maybe make it an opt-in checkbox in the export modal: "Include app name in filename" (unchecked by default). Priya Menon: Security/policy note: if customers use private naming, ensure export modal warns if filename contains PII or env names. Short copy: "Include app name in filename (may expose internal identifiers)". Gabe Liu: For long filenames we should sanitize characters and cap length to 120 chars. Also preserve file extension. Example sanitization function in implementation doc. Elena Ruiz: Keyboard flow question: when a user focuses a trace row and presses Enter, should we open the trace detail, or open the action menu? Current behavior opens detail which is natural, but power users asked for quick actions. Maybe Enter opens detail, Space opens actions, and "/" focuses the search? Tom Walters: Prefer Enter=detail, Space=action menu to avoid accidental menu opens. Document in keyboard help. Also expose a small tooltip on hover: "Enter to open, Space for actions". Priya Menon: For screen readers, ensure the row announces available actions. Example aria-label: "Trace 0xabc, 3 errors, press Space for actions, Enter to open." Keep it concise. a11y-checker: ARIA snippet suggestion:
and maintain aria-live updates for copy/export confirmations. Gabe Liu: Copy feedback: prefer inline ephemeral toast anchored to the row instead of global floating toast. E.g., small check + "Copied" for 1.2s. For screen readers send aria-live: "Frame copied to clipboard". Elena Ruiz: One more nuance: permalink shortlinks. If we generate shortlinks server-side, announce that a shortlink was created (e.g., "Short link copied"). Also track whether shortlink or full link chosen in analytics. Tom Walters: Good call. If clipboard API fails (mobile), fallback to preselected input in a modal and instruct user to long-press to copy. Handle gracefully. Priya Menon: I'll draft the accessible copy for the export modal and the menu aria-labels and post snippets here. Gabe Liu: I'll update the dev spec with filename sanitization rules and the markdown copy format examples. Elena Ruiz: Thanks all :thumbsup: I'll update Figma with the two-copy options and the inline toast state and tag @Priya/@Gabe when ready.
